decisions.source_zh_cn: 幻想锦标
ja: ファンタジーステークス
decisions.note: JP game name is verified as ファンタジーステークス, and JRA's official English naming identifies the race as Fantasy Stakes (within the sponsored full title KBS Kyoto Sho Fantasy Stakes). Preserve the proper race name rather than calquing zh-CN.

decisions.source_zh_cn: 府中赛马娘锦标
ja: 府中ウマ娘ステークス
decisions.note: JP game name is verified as 府中ウマ娘ステークス. Preserve Fuchu as the place name, Uma Musume as the locked series term, and Stakes as the race-name suffix; do not semantic-calque the zh-CN title.

decisions.source_zh_cn: 弥生赏
decisions.note: The game uses the historical JP name 弥生賞. JRA's pre-2020 official English form is Yayoi Sho; use that stable Roman form rather than translating the Chinese characters.
